candidate.requirement: Source matches tested copies and passes official validator; metadata and two-file runtime unchanged

STATE-02.requirement: Own acceptance stays in outcome, or independent successor has explicit start/handoff

STATE-03.requirement: Successful running checkpoint precedes coordinator product mutation

EVID-56-02.requirement: Check process has own observed returncode and attributable output
EVID-56-02.note: Original helper passes; same individual process receipt gate fails at coordinator

EVID-61-02.requirement: Evidence actual invocation matches executed call, reproduction separately labeled

plan-provenance.requirement: Current coordinator, tools, workspace and baseline; future owners separate

plan-only.requirement: No implementation, delegation or product execution

dispatch.requirement: Each successful worker dispatch persisted before next dispatch; actual handle and attempt

parallel.requirement: Two real disjoint workers overlap; single coordinator tracker writer; prerequisites accepted before integration

versions.requirement: Worker and integration evidence bind tested artifact versions

resume.requirement: Stale done revalidated; unknown send not replayed; missing tool blocked; safe bounded retries

negative.requirement: Both misleading-success cases retain check exit7 and following hash success, reject candidate

closeout.requirement: Accurate unresolved work and last-observed terminal handles

preservation.requirement: Protected fixture inputs and historical evidence/unrelated source unchanged

review.requirement: Independent raw-evidence review and final report, task list current

assessment-contract.requirement: Assessment task acceptance distinguishes completed verdict from candidate success
